 non-taxable transaction other than  cashing out what otherwise would have been a partial share of ViacomCBS.

taxable transaction other than cashing out what otherwise would have been a partial share in Walt Disney and a partial share in Fox.

in 2014, the fund previously known as Vanguard Tax-Managed International changed its name to Vanguard Developing Markets Index. In regard to Part VII, line

58. the insured died in 2014.
